description: Brutal, specific design critique of an existing page: automatic AI-slop detection (banned gradients, centered-hero defaults, h-screen bugs, cliche copy) plus a prioritized fix list with exact values. When you pass a URL, the response also includes LIVE SCREENSHOTS of the rendered page at phone (390px) and desktop (1440px) widths — look at them and fix what fails visually — and saves an unlisted SHAREABLE SCORE REPORT (score + category breakdown + screenshots) whose link you should give to the user. Always prefer passing the published URL over raw source for these reasons.

description.description: Description of the current design if no source available

direction.description: Direction pack id the page implements (e.g. ink-and-paper). ALWAYS pass this when the page was built from get_design_direction so the critique respects the design system instead of fighting it.

url.description: Public URL of the page to critique

name: critique_design
